name: dominodatalab
description: Domino Data Lab skills for Workspaces, Jobs, Compute Environments, Datasets, Projects, Apps, model endpoints and monitoring, MLflow experiment tracking, Flows, Spark/Ray/Dask/MPI clusters, LLM access, and the Domino APIs and SDKs, for Domino 6.1

settings.name: Domino URL
settings.description: Only for use outside a Domino Workspace: the address you open Domino at in your browser, for example https://domino.example.com. Leave empty inside a Workspace.

settings.name: Domino service account token
settings.description: Only for use outside a Domino Workspace: a service account token from your Domino administrator (only administrators can create one). Kept in your system keychain. Leave empty to use a user API key instead, or inside a Workspace.

settings.name: Domino user API key
settings.description: Only for use outside a Domino Workspace, when you have no service account token: your user API key from your Domino account settings. Used only when the token is empty. Kept in your system keychain. Leave empty inside a Workspace.
